title: 01 — Context
intro: Define asset, strategy, and horizon. The engine applies real costs to instruments and brokers that match the combination.
step1_desc: Select asset, strategy, and operational horizon. Available options change based on the selected context.
step2_desc: The engine applies spread, funding, commissions, and instrument structure to brokers consistent with the combination.
step3_desc: The most efficient combination for your operational case. Not a universal winner, but the right choice for the context.
